description: This file contains unit tests for the GstCapabilities class, which inspects GStreamer element factories, pads, and caps to determine supported media MIME types. It uses Google Test framework and mocks GStreamer wrapper functions to verify behavior across various decoder and parser configurations.

classes.name: GListWrapper
classes.description: A helper template class to manage GList of GStreamer objects, providing automatic cleanup.

classes.name: GstCapabilitiesTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing GstCapabilities behavior with various mock configurations.

methods.name: expectCapsToMimeMapping
methods.description: Sets expectations for converting string caps to GstCaps and unref operations.

methods.name: expectGetFactoryListAndFreeList
methods.description: Sets expectations for retrieving and freeing a list of element factories.

methods.name: expectGetStaticPadTemplates
methods.description: Sets expectations for retrieving static pad templates from a factory.

methods.name: expectGetStaticCapsAndCapsUnref
methods.description: Sets expectations for retrieving static caps from a pad template and unref operations.

methods.name: createSinkPadTemplate
methods.description: Creates a static sink pad template for testing.

methods.name: createSrcPadTemplate
methods.description: Creates a static source pad template for testing.
